chapterInfo.content:
15
Yuda asase no ahyeɛ
1 # Num 34.3-5 Na Yuda mma abusuakuo ntonto no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ no, ɛtɔɔ Edom hyeɛ ho kɔduruu Sin serɛ so, wɔ anafoɔ fam asase a ɛyɛ anafoɔ hyeɛ no awieeɛ so. 2Na wɔn anafoɔ fam hyeɛ no firi Nkyene Po awieeɛ no ho dɔnnɔn a ɛbu fa anafoɔ fam no ano. 3Na ɛnam Akrabim aforoeɛ anafoɔ fam sene kɔ Sin, na ɛforo kɔ anafoɔ fam wɔ Kades-barnea, na ɛtwam kɔ Hesron, na ɛforo kɔ Adar, na ɛpono kɔ Karka. 4Na ɛtwam kɔ Asmon, na ɛkɔpue Misraim subonhwa no ano, na ɛkɔpem mpoano. Yei nyɛ mo anafoɔ fam hyeɛ. 5Na apueeɛ hyeɛ ne Nkyene Po no de bɛsi Yordan awieeɛ. Na atifi fam hyeɛ no firi Nkyene Po ho dɔnnɔn a ɛwɔ Yordan awieeɛ no ho. 6#Yos 18.17 Na ɛhyeɛ no foro Bet-hogla, na ɛsene fa Bet-araba atifi fam, na ɛhyeɛ no foro kɔsi Ruben ba Bohan boɔ no ho. 7#2 Sa 17.17 Na ɛhyeɛ no firi Akor bonhwa no mu foro kɔ Debir, na ɛdane kɔ atifi fam kyerɛ Gilgal a ɛda Adumim aforoeɛ a ɛwɔ subonhwa no anafoɔ fam ntentensoɔ no. Na ɛhyeɛ no twam fa En-semes nsuo no ano, na ɛkɔpem En-rogel. 8#2 Be 28.3 Na ɛhyeɛ no foro fa Hinom ba bonhwa no mu, Yebusifoɔ nkyɛn mu anafoɔ fam, (ɛne Yerusalem); na ɛhyeɛ no foro kɔ bepɔ a ɛwɔ Hinom bonhwa no ntentensoɔ wɔ atɔeɛ wɔ Refaim bonhwa no atifi fam awieeɛ no atifi. 9#Yos 15.60 Na ɛhyeɛ no hima firi bepɔ no mpampam kɔ Neftoa asutire no ho, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Efron bepɔ so nkuro ho, na ɛhyeɛ no hima kɔ Baala (a ɛne Kiriat-yearim). 10Na ɛhyeɛ no konton firi Baala kɔ atɔeɛ, Seir bepɔ ho, na ɛsene kɔ Har-yearim, (ɛne Kesalon), nkyɛn mu wɔ atifi fam; na ɛsiane kɔ Bet-semes, na ɛsene kɔ Timna; 11na ɛhyeɛ no pue kɔ Ekron nkyɛn mu atifi fam na ɛhima kɔ Sikron, na ɛtwam kɔ Baala bepɔ no so, na ɛpue kɔ Yabneel; na ɛhyeɛ no kɔpem ɛpo no ano. 12Na atɔeɛ hyeɛ no ne ɛpo kɛseɛ no ne ɛho hyeɛ. Yeinom ne Yudafoɔ no hyeɛ a atwa ahyia sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Kaleb kyɛfa
13 # Yos 14.6-15; Ate 1.10-15 Na Yefune ba Kaleb deɛ, ɔmaa no kyɛfa, Yudafoɔ no mu sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Yosua no: (Anak agya Arba) kuro a ɛne Hebron. 14Na Kaleb tuu Anak mma baasa no firii hɔ, Sesai ne Ahiman ne Talmai, Anak asefoɔ. 15Na ɔfiri hɔ foro kɔɔ Debirfoɔ ho; nso akane no na Debir din ne Kiriat-sefer.
16Na Kaleb kaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔbɛbɔ Kiriat-sefer na ɔbɛfa no, mede me babaa Aksa bɛma no aware. 17Ɛnna Kaleb nua Kenas ba Otniel kɔfaeɛ, na ɔde ne babaa Aksa maa no awareɛ. 18Na ɔbaa no kɔɔ Otniel nkyɛn no, ɔhyɛɛ Otniel sɛ ɔmmisa n’agya Kaleb hɔ asase bi; na ɔbaa no firi n’afunumu so sii fam; na Kaleb ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na worehwehwɛ? 19Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ma me akyɛdeɛ bi ɛ, na anafoɔ asase na wode ama me nti, ma me mmasuo nso. Na ɔmaa no atifi mmasuo ne anafoɔ mmasuo. 20Yei ne Yuda mma abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.
Yuda nkuro
21Na Yudafoɔ abusuakuo no nkuro a ɛdeda anafoɔ fam pɛɛ de rekɔ Edom hyeɛ soɔ ne: Kabseel ne Eder ne Yagur, 22ne Kina ne Dimona ne Adada 23ne Kedes ne Hasor ne Itnan, 24Sif ne Telem ne Bealot, 25ne Hasor-hadata ne Keriot-hesron, (ɛne Hasor), 26Amam ne Sema ne Molada 27ne Hasar-gada ne Hesmon ne Bet-pelet, 28ne Hasar-sual ne Beer-seba ne ɛho nkuraa, 29Baala ne Iyim ne Esem, 30ne Eltolad ne Kesil ne Horma, 31ne Siklag ne Madmana ne Sansana, 32ne Lebaot ne Silhim ne Ain ne Rimon: Ne nyinaa yɛ nkuro aduonu nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
33 # Ate 13.25; 16.31 Ɛpo ho mpaperɛ so deɛ ne: Estaol ne Sora ne Asna, 34ne Sanoa ne En-ganim, Tapua ne Enam, 35Yarmut ne Adulam, Soko ne Aseka, 36ne Saaraim ne Aditaim ne Gedera ne Gederotaim: Nkuro dunan ne ɛho nkuraa.
37Senan ne Hadasa ne Migdal-gad 38ne Dilean ne Mispe ne Yokteel, 39Lakis ne Boskat ne Eglon, 40ne Kabon ne Lahmam ne Kitlis, 41ne Gederot, Bet-dagon ne Naama ne Makeda: Nkuro dunsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
42Libna ne Eter ne Asan, 43ne Yifta ne Asna ne Nesib 44#Yos 19.29 ne Keila ne Aksib ne Maresa: Nkuro nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
45 # 1 Sa 5.10 Ekron ne ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa, 46ɛfiri Ekron de kɔsi ɛpo fam deɛ ɛwɔ Asdod nkyɛn mu nyinaa ne ɛho nkuraa.
47 # 1 Sa 5.1; Ate 1.18; Num 34.6 Asdod, ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa, Gasa, ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa de kɔsi Misraim subonhwa no ano, ne Ɛpo Kɛseɛ ne ɛho hyeɛ.
48Na mmepɔ so deɛ ne: Samir ne Yatir ne Soko, 49ne Dana ne Kiriat-sana (a ɛne Debir), 50ne Anab ne Estemo ne Anim, 51ne Gosen ne Holon ne Gilo: Nkuro dubaako ne ɛho nkuraa.
52Arab ne Duma ne Esan, 53ne Yanum ne Bet-tapua ne Afeka 54ne Humta ne Kiriat-arba (a ɛne Hebron), ne Sior: Nkuro nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
55Maon, Karmel ne Sif ne Yuta, 56ne Yesreel ne Yokdeam ne Sanoa, 57Kain, Gibea ne Timna: Nkuro du ne ɛho nkuraa.
58Halhul, Bet-sur ne Gedor, 59ne Maarat ne Bet-anot ne Eltekon: Nkuro nsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
60 # Yos 9.17; 18.14 Kiriat-baal (a ɛne Kiriat-yearim), ne Raba: Nkuro mmienu ne ɛho nkuraa.
61Ɛserɛ so deɛ ne: Bet-araba, Midin ne Sekaka 62ne Nibsan ne Nkyene Kuro no ne En-gedi: Nkuro nsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
63 # Yos 18.28; 2 Sa 5.6 Na Yebusifoɔ a wɔte Yerusalem no deɛ, Yudafoɔ no antumi antu wɔn, na Yebusifoɔ no ne Yudafoɔ no tenaa Yerusalem de bɛduru nnɛ yi.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Yuda mma abusuakuo ntonto no, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ no, ɛtɔɔ Edom hyeɛ ho kɔduruu Sin serɛ so, wɔ anafoɔ fam asase a ɛyɛ anafoɔ hyeɛ no awieeɛ so. Na wɔn anafoɔ fam hyeɛ no firi Nkyene Po awieeɛ no ho dɔnnɔn a ɛbu fa anafoɔ fam no ano. Na ɛnam Akrabim aforoeɛ anafoɔ fam sene kɔ Sin, na ɛforo kɔ anafoɔ fam wɔ Kades-barnea, na ɛtwam kɔ Hesron, na ɛforo kɔ Adar, na ɛpono kɔ Karka. Na ɛtwam kɔ Asmon, na ɛkɔpue Misraim subonhwa no ano, na ɛkɔpem mpoano. Yei nyɛ mo anafoɔ fam hyeɛ. Na apueeɛ hyeɛ ne Nkyene Po no de bɛsi Yordan awieeɛ. Na atifi fam hyeɛ no firi Nkyene Po ho dɔnnɔn a ɛwɔ Yordan awieeɛ no ho. Na ɛhyeɛ no foro Bet-hogla, na ɛsene fa Bet-araba atifi fam, na ɛhyeɛ no foro kɔsi Ruben ba Bohan boɔ no ho. Na ɛhyeɛ no firi Akor bonhwa no mu foro kɔ Debir, na ɛdane kɔ atifi fam kyerɛ Gilgal a ɛda Adumim aforoeɛ a ɛwɔ subonhwa no anafoɔ fam ntentensoɔ no. Na ɛhyeɛ no twam fa En-semes nsuo no ano, na ɛkɔpem En-rogel. Na ɛhyeɛ no foro fa Hinom ba bonhwa no mu, Yebusifoɔ nkyɛn mu anafoɔ fam, (ɛne Yerusalem); na ɛhyeɛ no foro kɔ bepɔ a ɛwɔ Hinom bonhwa no ntentensoɔ wɔ atɔeɛ wɔ Refaim bonhwa no atifi fam awieeɛ no atifi. Na ɛhyeɛ no hima firi bepɔ no mpampam kɔ Neftoa asutire no ho, na ɛfiri hɔ kɔ Efron bepɔ so nkuro ho, na ɛhyeɛ no hima kɔ Baala (a ɛne Kiriat-yearim). Na ɛhyeɛ no konton firi Baala kɔ atɔeɛ, Seir bepɔ ho, na ɛsene kɔ Har-yearim, (ɛne Kesalon), nkyɛn mu wɔ atifi fam; na ɛsiane kɔ Bet-semes, na ɛsene kɔ Timna; na ɛhyeɛ no pue kɔ Ekron nkyɛn mu atifi fam na ɛhima kɔ Sikron, na ɛtwam kɔ Baala bepɔ no so, na ɛpue kɔ Yabneel; na ɛhyeɛ no kɔpem ɛpo no ano. Na atɔeɛ hyeɛ no ne ɛpo kɛseɛ no ne ɛho hyeɛ. Yeinom ne Yudafoɔ no hyeɛ a atwa ahyia sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.

Na Yefune ba Kaleb deɛ, ɔmaa no kyɛfa, Yudafoɔ no mu sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ Yosua no: (Anak agya Arba) kuro a ɛne Hebron. Na Kaleb tuu Anak mma baasa no firii hɔ, Sesai ne Ahiman ne Talmai, Anak asefoɔ. Na ɔfiri hɔ foro kɔɔ Debirfoɔ ho; nso akane no na Debir din ne Kiriat-sefer.
Na Kaleb kaa sɛ: Deɛ ɔbɛbɔ Kiriat-sefer na ɔbɛfa no, mede me babaa Aksa bɛma no aware. Ɛnna Kaleb nua Kenas ba Otniel kɔfaeɛ, na ɔde ne babaa Aksa maa no awareɛ. Na ɔbaa no kɔɔ Otniel nkyɛn no, ɔhyɛɛ Otniel sɛ ɔmmisa n’agya Kaleb hɔ asase bi; na ɔbaa no firi n’afunumu so sii fam; na Kaleb ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na worehwehwɛ? Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ma me akyɛdeɛ bi ɛ, na anafoɔ asase na wode ama me nti, ma me mmasuo nso. Na ɔmaa no atifi mmasuo ne anafoɔ mmasuo. Yei ne Yuda mma abusuakuo no agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua teɛ.

Na Yudafoɔ abusuakuo no nkuro a ɛdeda anafoɔ fam pɛɛ de rekɔ Edom hyeɛ soɔ ne: Kabseel ne Eder ne Yagur, ne Kina ne Dimona ne Adada ne Kedes ne Hasor ne Itnan, Sif ne Telem ne Bealot, ne Hasor-hadata ne Keriot-hesron, (ɛne Hasor), Amam ne Sema ne Molada ne Hasar-gada ne Hesmon ne Bet-pelet, ne Hasar-sual ne Beer-seba ne ɛho nkuraa, Baala ne Iyim ne Esem, ne Eltolad ne Kesil ne Horma, ne Siklag ne Madmana ne Sansana, ne Lebaot ne Silhim ne Ain ne Rimon: Ne nyinaa yɛ nkuro aduonu nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ɛpo ho mpaperɛ so deɛ ne: Estaol ne Sora ne Asna, ne Sanoa ne En-ganim, Tapua ne Enam, Yarmut ne Adulam, Soko ne Aseka, ne Saaraim ne Aditaim ne Gedera ne Gederotaim: Nkuro dunan ne ɛho nkuraa.
Senan ne Hadasa ne Migdal-gad ne Dilean ne Mispe ne Yokteel, Lakis ne Boskat ne Eglon, ne Kabon ne Lahmam ne Kitlis, ne Gederot, Bet-dagon ne Naama ne Makeda: Nkuro dunsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
Libna ne Eter ne Asan, ne Yifta ne Asna ne Nesib ne Keila ne Aksib ne Maresa: Nkuro nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ekron ne ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa, ɛfiri Ekron de kɔsi ɛpo fam deɛ ɛwɔ Asdod nkyɛn mu nyinaa ne ɛho nkuraa.
Asdod, ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa, Gasa, ɛho nkuro ne nkuraa de kɔsi Misraim subonhwa no ano, ne Ɛpo Kɛseɛ ne ɛho hyeɛ.
Na mmepɔ so deɛ ne: Samir ne Yatir ne Soko, ne Dana ne Kiriat-sana (a ɛne Debir), ne Anab ne Estemo ne Anim, ne Gosen ne Holon ne Gilo: Nkuro dubaako ne ɛho nkuraa.
Arab ne Duma ne Esan, ne Yanum ne Bet-tapua ne Afeka ne Humta ne Kiriat-arba (a ɛne Hebron), ne Sior: Nkuro nkron ne ɛho nkuraa.
Maon, Karmel ne Sif ne Yuta, ne Yesreel ne Yokdeam ne Sanoa, Kain, Gibea ne Timna: Nkuro du ne ɛho nkuraa.
Halhul, Bet-sur ne Gedor, ne Maarat ne Bet-anot ne Eltekon: Nkuro nsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
Kiriat-baal (a ɛne Kiriat-yearim), ne Raba: Nkuro mmienu ne ɛho nkuraa.
Ɛserɛ so deɛ ne: Bet-araba, Midin ne Sekaka ne Nibsan ne Nkyene Kuro no ne En-gedi: Nkuro nsia ne ɛho nkuraa.
Na Yebusifoɔ a wɔte Yerusalem no deɛ, Yudafoɔ no antumi antu wɔn, na Yebusifoɔ no ne Yudafoɔ no tenaa Yerusalem de bɛduru nnɛ yi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
